---
title: "Animate.css Extension for Quarto"
subtitle: "Quarto Extension"
author:
  - name: "Mickaël CANOUIL, _Ph.D._"
    orcid: "0000-0002-3396-4549"

format:
  html:
    toc: true
extensions:
  animate:
    duration: 1s
    delay: 1s
    repeat: 1
---

Name the effect, give it the text, and the extension writes the animated span.

```markdown
{{{< animate bounce "Some text" >}}}
```

{{< animate bounce "Some text" >}}

Timing is set per call, or once under `extensions.animate` as in this document's front matter.

```markdown
{{{< animate tada "Some text" duration=2s repeat=3 >}}}
```

{{< animate tada "Some text" duration=2s repeat=3 >}}

Full documentation, including all ninety-seven effects: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-animate/>.
